create_RobustCostFunction: create a RobustCostFunction wrapping a CostFunction with a RobustLoss class and log_loss_radius Variable
use_weighted_error: compute the robust weighted error tensor by evaluating the loss on the squared norm of weighted residuals
use_weighted_jacobians_error: compute rescaled jacobians and error tensors by linearizing the robust loss and applying the rescale factor
create_GNCRobustCostFunction: create a GNCRobustCostFunction with a GNCRobustLoss class, log_loss_radius, and gnc_control_val for GNC annealing
review_RobustCostFunction_flatten_dims: review the RobustCostFunction flatten_dims flag to apply the robust loss per error dimension independently
